limitation: Review and select explicitly. Stop Node.js, Playwright and Cypress first. Offline browser tests may fail until the required runtime is downloaded again; configuration and project files are retained.

name: Maps and location caches
rebuildNote: macOS regenerates this user cache when the service needs it again.
limitation: Only the named directory under the current user's Library/Caches is included. Protected files remain blocked; preferences, personal data and downloaded models outside the cache are retained.
